name: spec-compliance-verifier
description: Advisory verification of a supplied spec, acceptance criteria, diff summary and code excerpts for product/spec drift.
when_to_use: Use to check an implementation diff against spec text and acceptance criteria; returns a strict JSON advisory artifact, never a merge decision.
